snippet.title: Thunderbirds (GBC) playthrough ~Longplay~
snippet.description:
This is a playthrough of Thunderbirds for Game Boy Colour.

An adaptation of the classic TV series, this game sees the International Rescue take on the Hood once more.

It sure is a game, alright.
